slides.title: What This Research Does
bullets: Transforms how AI models process language
Eliminates the need for sequential computation
Enables parallel processing at national scale
slides.script: Good morning. Today I want to tell you about a breakthrough that is quietly powering every AI system you interact with - from translation services to document analysis.
slides.speaker_notes: Pause after 'Good morning'. Make eye contact. Do not use jargon.

sentences.text: Good morning. Today I want to tell you about a breakthrough that is quietly powering every AI system you interact with.

slides.title: The Core Innovation
bullets: Attention: the model focuses only on what matters
Already adopted by ANRF-funded research teams
slides.script: The key innovation is called attention. Think of it like a spotlight that the system uses to highlight only the most relevant information when answering a question.
slides.speaker_notes: Use the spotlight analogy. Avoid 'dot-product' or 'softmax'.
